title: I HAVE a message from the Lord Halleluyah

lines.text: I HAVE a message from the Lord Halleluyah
The message all unto you I‘ll give
T'is recorded in His word, halleluyah
Look up to Jesus alone and live.
look and Iive..My brother, live
look to Jesus now and live
Tis recorded in His word Halleluyah
It is only that you Look and live.
I've a message full of love, halleluyah
A message, O my friend, ‘tis for you
Its a message from above, halleluyah
Jesus said it and I know ‘tis true.
To the universal Church Halleluyah
Jesus call unto Thee come! oh! come
Salvation, free, He offered, Halleluyah
Jesus let us worship and be saved.
Jesus, Blessed Saviour, Lord, Halleluyah
Glory, Honour to Thy sacred name
For Thy saving grace bestowed, Halleluyah
Praises offered to the trinity.
Cherubim and Seraphim, Halleluyah
Satan confront till life shall endure
Crown of glory shall ye gain, Hellcluyuh
Before the throne of Father above.
